newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank sector climate index falls in June.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank sector climate index falls in June.

text.p: Poland's banking climate index fell 0.5 point to 46.8 points in June after declining two points in May, a poll released on Friday by the private Pentor institute showed.
The monthly survey showed the so-called "Pengab" index dipped due to lower bank evaluations of zloty term deposits.
The index, based on a scale of minus 100 to plus 100, polled 205 bank managers and is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP). -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
